quarterly_data.quarter: Sakura Internet semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 15,631,162 thousand (+17.8%) as GPU infrastructure services grew on GPU investments made in the previous and current fiscal years, despite the expiry of a large government contract at the previous fiscal year end; operating loss JPY 920,815 thousand (prior-year first half: operating profit JPY 1,295,887 thousand) as GPU infrastructure services sales growth lagged while depreciation, server maintenance, data-center rent and power costs rose; ordinary loss JPY 811,762 thousand; net loss attributable to owners of parent JPY 626,763 thousand. By category: cloud services JPY 7,509,170 thousand (+10.2%), GPU infrastructure services JPY 2,820,758 thousand (+25.9%), physical base services JPY 1,577,929 thousand (-4.1%), other services JPY 3,723,303 thousand (+44.8%) on winning large projects
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 15,631,162 thousand (+17.8%); operating loss JPY 920,815 thousand; GPU infrastructure services JPY 2,820,758 thousand (+25.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sakura Internet semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: New-facility plans at Ishikari Data Center as of September 30, 2025: GPU, network and storage equipment JPY 21,400 million (JPY 21,532 million paid; started April 2024, completion by December 2025 planned); a further GPU, network and storage investment of JPY 36,668 million planned to start January 2026 or later and complete November 2026 or later; the container-type data center JPY 17,000 million (JPY 2,554 million paid), completion planned November 2026. New Ishikari equipment added (GPU, network and storage equipment, Building 3 zone A and others) had a book value of JPY 26,331,817 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: next GPU investment JPY 36,668 million (start January 2026 or later); container data center completion November 2026 planned
